title: QA run · surface:mixed (90/90) · 36b2889c · 2026-10-12 · 72 PASS / 10 PARTIAL / 8 FAIL / 0 BLOCKED / 0 NOT-RUN
body:
Half 2 of #23104, mixed selector. The maintainer's order, verbatim: 「objectui pin 更新到最新版，并使用浏览器对前端界面进行完整的测试」. Every runnable `surface:mixed` item (API truth plus a console surface) was driven against objectstack `36b2889c`, with the console built from the new objectui pin `1fb1ced36243` (a local stand-in for PR #23110's head). The `surface:browser` record for the same subject and run is #23163. Text only: screenshots were consulted live as oracles and are not attached. The durable truth stays in `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/`.

## Environment fingerprint

- **Framework (subject):** `objectstack-ai/objectstack` **`36b2889cddc5e38acf7f85b8e186b02e6ef786c6`**, in the detached worktree `/home/user/objectstack-qa-23104`, framework and console built.
- **Console:** `.objectui-sha` set LOCALLY to **`1fb1ced36243c325acc801bdde26bd096a15f5f5`**, with `sdui.manifest.json` and `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json` regenerated from the built objectui tree at that pin (sha256 `f545b851c4bb…`, byte-identical to PR #23110's). The console dist stamp equals the pin, both in `packages/console/dist/.objectui-sha` and as served by `GET /_console/.objectui-sha`.
- **Why this tree stands in for the pin PR:** it differs from PR #23110's head `043b81d13` only in pin-citation strings inside spec descriptions, the sdui-parser lockstep JSON, two changesets and one docs reference page. Runtime code and console bundle are identical. PR #23110 has since landed on `main` as `f451a5964`, and CI push run `38332364381` at `bcebd8409`, the first full-battery `main` run carrying it, passed with `Console Pin Gate` included.
- **Checklist:** items, `RUNNER.md` and the selector come from the subject tree. Revisions in the table match the selector's output.
- **App / boots:** `examples/app-showcase` booted with `objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin -p PORT -d file:/tmp/qa-23104/LANE/ITEM.db`, with `OS_PORT` exported and a per-boot `OS_HOME` and `OS_STORAGE_LOCAL_ROOT`. Lanes A / B / C used the ports 44100–44399 / 44400–44699 / 44700–44999. Browser: Playwright on `/opt/pw-browsers/chromium`. Admin `admin@objectos.ai` came from `--seed-admin`. Other personas were minted per item, and identity was proven with `get-session` before each persona cell.
- **Execution:** three parallel runner subagents (lanes A, B, C) in Claude Code session `session_016JB93R2KcQP4GgKaUnseVF`, PM seat `domain:devx#2`, from about 23:30Z on 2026-10-12.
  - A container restart around 02:30Z killed all three. Each lane resumed from its own results file: judged items were kept byte-identical, and not-run items were re-run from scratch on fresh `-r2` state.
  - The lanes finished on 2026-10-13, between 03:32Z and 04:28Z. Concurrency stayed at three lanes.
  - Tier-1 pins in this repository ran under `os-verify-lock` and are cited. objectui-only pins were driven by hand, or run from an objectui checkout at the pin where installed.
- **Hop regression: none.** Every fail clause records `hop_suspect: false`. `concurrent-edit-conflict` N2 also carries an explicit hop-range `git log` over `ObjectGrid.tsx` that returned empty.
- **Deviations, stated** (the full list is on #23163):
  - **The CRM manifest incident** (03:44:53–03:45:18Z, removed through the API, `git status` unchanged). No boot that scored an app-list clause started in that window.
  - **Declared shared boots:** lane B S1 / S2, lane C `studio1`, and one shared DB for `lifecycle-retention-sweep` + `interrupted-migration-boot-report`.
  - **Scratch showcase copies under `/tmp`:** capability probes, walled-posture boots, the picklist fixture, job fixtures and webhook stacks.
  - **Non-default boots:**
    - `OS_LOG_LEVEL=info` for the lifecycle / migration INFO lines; at the default level every migration-recovery line is WARN, so it cannot hide one.
    - `OS_LOCALIZATION_TIMEZONE` / `OS_MAIL_SMTP_PASSWORD` (env-lock legs) and `OS_TENANCY_POSTURE=group|isolated` with `OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL` and `OS_AUTH_MEMBERSHIP_POLICY=invite-only`.
    - `OS_PAGE_REACT=off`, the scheduled-work boot, the local OIDC provider fixture (oidc2) and a scratch PostgreSQL 16 on 127.0.0.1:44790.
  - **The two `cli.scaffold-*` items took the PUBLISHED path.** `create-objectstack@latest` = 17.7.0 and the published console = objectui `0abd4f9f8769`, so their verdicts describe the released bits, not the local pin. The tree's CLI refuses a 17.x scaffold on the ADR-0087 D1 protocol handshake, and the pre-release variant is handed off (see Scope).
  - **Pins re-run at resume:** one lane-B Tier-1 pin was re-run under the lock (2 files, 33/33), and so was lane C's `metadata-diagnostics-sweep` A7.
  - **Time split** (environment / test minutes, lane estimates): A 17 / 103 (resumed portion only), B ≈38 / 220, C ≈34 / 190.

## Fails — reproduction rules and dispositions

### Product defects

**records-forms.concurrent-edit-conflict · N2:** product defect, objectstack-ai/objectui#12292.
1. On a fresh boot as admin, open `/_console/apps/showcase_app/showcase_task/view/grid` (inline edit on). Note that Ingest pipeline's Estimate reads 60.
2. Concurrently `PATCH /api/v1/data/showcase_task/ID {estimate_hours:77}` with If-Match set to its updated_at → 200.
3. In the stale grid, click the Estimate cell, type 61, press Enter and click "Save All (1)".
- **Expected:** the grid save rides the OCC token, and the stale write is refused 409 with the conflict dialog (the item's negative: an unguarded inline save is a FAIL).
- **Actual:** `PATCH /api/v1/data/showcase_task/ID {estimate_hours:61}` goes out with no If-Match → 200, and the re-read is 61. No 409, dialog or toast. Reproduced twice (77 → 61, 33 → 31).
- **Source:** plugin-grid `ObjectGrid.tsx` `defaultRowSave` / `defaultBatchSave` call `dataSource.update(object, id, changes)` with no ifMatch. The hop range is empty.

**platform-core.app-management-toggle · C5b:** product defect, objectstack-ai/objectui#12300.
1. On the stock showcase, sign in as admin through the form and open `/_console/apps/setup/system/apps`.
2. Click `getByRole('button',{name:'Delete Showcase'})`, then `getByRole('button',{name:'Confirm delete Showcase'})`.
- **Wire:** `DELETE /api/v1/meta/app/showcase_app` → 200 `{success:true, reset:false, message:'No customization overlay found … already at artifact default.'}`.
